name: Protinex Chocolate Flavour
ingredients_raw: SKIMMED MILK POWDER, MALT EXTRACT, SOY PROTEIN ISOLATE, COCOA POWDER (10%), MINERALS (DI CALCIUM PHOSPHATE, FERRIC PYROPHOSPHATE, ZINC SULPHATE, POTASSIUM IODIDE), NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, MALTODEXTRIN, STABILIZER (GUAR GUM), VITAMINS (CHOLINE BITARTRATE, ASCORBIC ACID, DL-ALPHA TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, NICOTINAMIDE, RETINYL ACETATE, ERGOCALCIFEROL, THIAMINE HYDROCHLORIDE, CALCIUM PANTOTHENATE, RIBOFLAVIN, PYRIDOXINE HYDROCHLORIDE, FOLIC ACID, D-BIOTIN), SWEETENER (SUCRALOSE). ALLERGEN INFORMATION: CONTAINS MILK, BARLEY & SOY. MAY CONTAIN PEANUT & WHEAT
